messages:
Avery: Quick follow-up thread from today's all-hands. Short Qs only about the API streaming, Console model billing, and Optimize timeline so we can publish a clean recap.

Priya: TL;DR: streaming alpha -> ~3 weeks, Console per-model billing beta -> ~6 weeks, Optimize quant advisor preview -> early Q3. Will attach a calendar after this thread.

Jordan: For the Console beta, will finance be able to export per-model monthly cost CSVs?

Priya: Yes, beta includes CSV export for per-model and per-route breakdowns. Finance + Billing roles get access.

Marco: Streaming note: alpha requires a small kernel tweak and a KV cache change. Canary plan: small Dedicated pool -> wider Dedicated -> hosted. If kernel slips, alpha slides by 1 week.

Rhea: Will Dedicated customers have to resize pools to opt into low-latency?

Marco: We will surface a "recommended pool size" in Console when toggling. No forced changes. Recommendations are just that.

Sam: SDK/devex: SDK 1.5 will add streaming helpers and a low_latency flag. Docs + migration guide ship with the SDK. Example for docs draft:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-medium","streaming_mode":"low_latency","input":"Summarize the plan."}'
```

Avery: Who's owning the public-facing release note and FAQ? need a short opt-in blurb for customers.

Jordan: I'll own comms with CS + Sales. Draft email + FAQ by Friday.

OpsBot: Runbook skeleton created: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/streaming-alpha (owner: Marco)

Priya: Action items recap: Priya posts calendar, Marco posts runbook + canary checklist, Sam opens SDK PR + docs, Jordan drafts comms. Reply here when you start. Closing thread.
